logo.prompt: A soft, elegant logo reveal: a gentle airy whoosh rising into a warm, clean bell chime that rings out. Minimal, calm, premium, not loud.

tap.prompt: A single soft, muted wooden tap on a desk. Very short, dry and subtle, no echo.

pop.prompt: A tiny, soft, rounded pop, like a small dot appearing on a page. Gentle and quiet interface sound.

pencil.prompt: A quick pencil stroke on paper, a short soft scratch as if underlining a word. Close and quiet.

scratch.prompt: A quick pencil scribble crossing out a word on paper. Short, soft and dry.

whoosh.prompt: A very soft, airy paper whoosh, like a sheet of paper sliding past. Subtle, short and smooth.

sprinkle.prompt: A light patter of tiny dry grains scattering onto paper, soft and quick, fading away.

chime.prompt: A single soft glass bell note with a gentle warm decay. Calm, quiet and clear.

reveal-line.prompt: A very soft, short slide of a paper card into place on a desk. Subtle, close and quiet.

reveal-whoosh.prompt: A single soft, airy whoosh passing quickly from one side to the other. Smooth, subtle and short.

reveal-click.prompt: One gentle, muted click of two smooth wooden blocks touching. Dry, close and quiet.

reveal-pen.prompt: One smooth felt-tip marker stroke drawn across paper in a single continuous curve, soft and close, about one second long.

reveal-marimba.prompt: A quick rising run of soft wooden marimba notes climbing in pitch, evenly spaced, about one second long.

reveal-shimmer.prompt: A light shimmer of tiny glass grains swirling inward and gathering together, growing slightly louder, then stopping.

reveal-thud.prompt: One small, soft thud of a light object landing on a cushioned table, with a tiny bounce.

reveal-land-marimba.prompt: A single warm, soft chord on a wooden marimba, struck once with soft yarn mallets, round and mellow, ringing out gently.

reveal-land-felt.prompt: A single soft, warm felt piano chord, played gently once and left to ring, mellow, intimate and round.

reveal-land-pluck.prompt: A single soft, warm, round synth pluck chord, low and mellow, with a short gentle tail.
